selection.admission_policy: No hard descriptive comparisons without empirical calibration. Unit and name known agreements weight 1; type and year diagnostic. Address supplied in a separate corroboration run and soft only.
selection.algorithm: minimum SHA256(seed + property_name) over untested Tampa cohort from retained NXRT Q4 2025 supplement
selection.inventory_scope: Hillsborough County parcels with DOR code 03xx; selected solely from public geography and property type
selection.name_policy: ASCII case and whitespace normalization; soft exact agreement only
selection.selection_limit: Only one untested member remains in the supported Hillsborough geography; this is a held-out case, not random population accuracy.

timing_conditions: Local debug build with concurrent experiment and quality-gate execution; timings are observations, not portfolio throughput estimates.
